_README: Physics only (house, wall, heat pump, tank): STILL PLACEHOLDERS until the thermal expert confirms (energy flag F6). Cities, weather files, tariffs, costs, discount rate and lifetime come from energy/03_inputs/inputs.csv (sourced). Overridden from there: heat_pump.capex_usd_per_kW_thermal, wall.insulation_k, costs.*.

house._note: Envelope, mass, gains, solar, sky loss and air exchange are derived from the team standard-house baseline v2 (ISO 13790 reference home) at this floor area by house_v2.py: R-20 walls, R-49 ceiling, R-30 floor, U-0.30/SHGC-0.30 windows at 20.8% of wall, 0.35 ACH, light mass, RESNET 301 gains, 68/78 F deadband, latent to 50% RH.

wall._baseline_note: 95 mm of XPS (k 0.0288) + drywall + films = R-20 effective wall (baseline v2)

heat_pump._cop_note: Generic heat pump curves from baseline v2 (Model and sources sheet), converted from F; COP 1 (resistance) below the -25 C cutoff

tank._cost_note: Tank cost, O&M and lifetime come from energy/03_inputs/costs_sourced_2026.csv (installed $/kWh_th, residential or commercial).

small_office._note: ASSUMED preset (not sourced): ~200 m2 single-storey office, occupied 8am-6pm weekdays, 15 W/m2 internal gains when occupied. Envelope and mass scaled from the house by floor area; more glazing. Constant setpoint (no night setback). Tariff = each city's TOU+demand as a stand-in: no sourced commercial demand tariff yet (e.g. APS E-32, PG&E B-19, SDG&E AL-TOU, FPL GSD-1, Eversource G-2).
